text:
Alex: Heads-up — NewBridge (acct NB-451) requested a retro credit and extended payment terms. They were quoted a custom 10% onboarding discount for 3 months (sales note), but the invoice V-9902 billed full amount and net30. Customer is asking for $4,200 credit + net60.

Mei: I see the deal comments: '10% onboarding off base usage M1-M3, Net60 for pilot only, approved by SDR'. But there's no Deal Desk ticket. Invoice V-9902 total = $42,000. 10% = $4,200.

Tomas: Policy: any customer-term change to payment terms requires Finance Lead + Sales Manager sign-off. Discounts >$2k need Deal Desk recorded. This is $4,200 so two approvals needed. Also need to know if this impacts EOM revenue recognition.

Alex: Sales Ops pinged legal; legal says email approval from SDR isn't a signed amendment, but we can treat as a one-time commercial concession (no contract change) if Deal Desk approves.

Priya: From AR perspective, Net60 is fine as a one-off, but we need CFO or Finance Lead to ok. I can provisionally queue the credit memo once approvals exist.

Alex: Opening Deal Desk now — DD-2026-001 created with attachments. Tagging @Tomas for sign-off and @Mei for Sales Ops confirmation.

Mei: Confirmed from Sales Ops: AE confirmed onboarding discount in email on 2026-01-03. Recommend honoring to avoid churn during pilot.

Tomas: Approve DD-2026-001. Approver notes: one-time credit CM-2026-01-12, GL 6510 (Customer Discounts), memo 'one-time onboarding discount honored per AE email'. Net60 approved for this invoice only.

Alex: Draft customer message: "We've issued a one-time onboarding credit of $4,200 and updated invoice payment terms to Net60 for this invoice only. This doesn't change your contract pricing going forward." Send? :email:

Mei: Send after credit posts. Also request BillingBot to queue credit.

Alex: BillingBot, please queue credit memo CM-2026-01-12 for invoice V-9902 amount=4200 reason='onboarding discount (AE commitment)'.

BillingBot: queued credit memo CM-2026-01-12 (amount: $4,200) for V-9902. ETA: 24h to appear on customer account. Reference: #CM-2026-01-12.

Priya: I'll mark the AR sheet and flag revenue recognition note for month close. SQL check used for audit:
```
SELECT invoice_id, total_amount, discount_pct, total_amount * discount_pct AS credit
FROM invoices
WHERE invoice_id = 'V-9902';
```
Result: V-9902, 42000, 0.10, 4200

Tomas: All good. Document DD-2026-001 in Deal Desk with GL 6510. No contract amendment required per Legal.

BillingBot: CM-2026-01-12 posted to customer account at 2026-01-05T11:22:03Z.

Alex: Confirmed posting. Sent customer note and they replied thanks. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
